name: docker-fleet
description: Multi-host Docker management with AI. Auto-discover Docker hosts from your bastion, see every container across the fleet in one view, manage Compose stacks, scan images for vulnerabilities, and let CommanderQ diagnose container issues from logs and memory.
shortDescription: Fleet-wide Docker management with AI diagnostics and auto-discovery.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Auto-discover Docker hosts from your bastion -- zero configuration
Unified container view across all hosts with real-time stats
AI-powered log analysis and incident memory
Compose stack management with drift detection
Image vulnerability scanning with prioritised CVE reports
Network topology visualisation and volume management
Natural language container operations via CommanderQ

fleetDiscovery.name: Fleet Auto-Discovery
fleetDiscovery.description: Automatically find all Docker hosts in your fleet via bastion SSH. No manual configuration needed.

containerManagement.name: Container Management
containerManagement.description: Start, stop, restart, inspect, and monitor containers across every host from one dashboard.

composeStacks.name: Compose Stack Management
composeStacks.description: Manage Docker Compose stacks fleet-wide. Deploy, update, and detect drift between running state and compose files.

aiDiagnostics.name: AI Diagnostics
aiDiagnostics.description: CommanderQ analyses container logs, correlates events across hosts, and remembers past incidents to speed up troubleshooting.

imageSecurity.name: Image Security Scanning
imageSecurity.description: Scan images for CVEs with Trivy. Prioritised vulnerability reports with fix recommendations.

networkTopology.name: Network Topology
networkTopology.description: Visualise container networks across hosts. See which containers can communicate and identify isolated services.

liveEvents.name: Live Event Stream
liveEvents.description: Real-time Docker daemon events across the fleet with AI-powered annotation and cross-host correlation.

requirements.external: Docker running on fleet hosts accessible via bastion SSH

changes: Unified container view across all Docker hosts
Docker system disk usage per host
DOCKER specialist agent with fleet awareness

quickActions.label: Containers
quickActions.description: List all containers across Docker fleet
quickActions.prompt: List all Docker containers across the fleet with their status

quickActions.label: Fleet Health
quickActions.description: Check Docker host connectivity and resource usage
quickActions.prompt: Check health of all Docker hosts and flag any that are unreachable or resource-constrained
